expo.name: Foundry
expo._comment_userInterfaceStyle: Pinned dark, not automatic (#46): src/theme has one palette because the web app has one — there is no light scheme to fall back to, and 'automatic' would hand the OS a light keyboard and light sheet grabbers on a black app.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to scan food barcodes and find nutrition information, take progress photos, and record form-check videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Foundry uses your photos so you can attach a progress photo to a session.
plugins.cameraPermission: Foundry uses the camera so you can take a progress photo.

plugins.photosPermission: Foundry uses your photos to save progress photos and form-check videos.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Foundry saves progress photos and form-check videos to your library.

expo._comment_locales: iOS permission prompts are compiled into the native app, so the camera purpose string is localized here for both languages Foundry ships.
